# Heroku: Cloud Application Platform

> Experience fully managed app hosting that just works\. Build, deploy, and scale on the battle\-tested platform that defines the industry\.

Generated by Yoast SEO v28.7, this is an llms.txt file, meant for consumption by LLMs.

## Posts
- [Securing Your Stack: Recent PHP and eMudhra Updates on Heroku](https://www.heroku.com/blog/securing-your-stack-recent-php-and-emudhra-updates-on-heroku/): Managing critical vulnerabilities often consumes significant engineering time\. When two remote code execution flaws hit PHP alongside the eMudhra root certificate compromise, Heroku managed the heavy lifting for their managed runtimes\.
- [Front\-End Web Deep Dive: Runtime Config](https://www.heroku.com/blog/front-end-web-deep-dive-runtime-config/): Runtime configuration has been brought to the Front\-End Web Cloud Native Buildpack in a way that is standard, secure, and requires zero re\-builds\. By revisiting Twelve\-Factor principles through the lens of modern web standards, we have created a strategy that works for any framework\.
- [Improved Static Website Support on Heroku with Front\-End Web Cloud Native Buildpack](https://www.heroku.com/blog/improved-static-website-support-with-front-end-web-cloud-native-buildpack/)
- [October 2026 Update: Heroku Innovations and New Features](https://www.heroku.com/blog/october-2026-update-heroku-innovations-features/)
- [A New Era for Managed Databases: Announcing Heroku Postgres Advanced](https://www.heroku.com/blog/new-era-managed-databases-announcing-heroku-postgres-advanced/): At Heroku, we’ve built a platform that allows developers to focus on their apps, not managing their infrastructure\. Heroku Postgres Advanced carries forward that philosophy as our next\-generation database offering, available today\.

## Customers
- [Leave a Nest](https://www.heroku.com/customers/leaveanest/): Leave a Nest's User Base Soars from 600 to 30,000 with Heroku PaaS
- [Leather Spa](https://www.heroku.com/customers/leatherspa/): How Leather Spa Scales Business and Revenue Efficiently with Heroku
- [Trailhead](https://www.heroku.com/customers/trailhead/): Trailhead Achieves Scalable Growth and Faster Publishing with Heroku
- [Stratis Global](https://www.heroku.com/customers/stratis-global/): Stratis Global Cuts Build Time by Over 35 Percent by Switching to a Heroku\-First Strategy
- [THINKMD](https://www.heroku.com/customers/thinkmd/): THINKMD Delivers a Frontline Healthcare Assessment Platform on Heroku

## Events
- [AWS Summit NYC](https://www.heroku.com/events/2025/aws-summit-nyc/): Join Heroku at AWS Summit NYC on July 16, 2025
- [KubeCon \+ CloudNativeCon Europe 2025](https://www.heroku.com/events/2025/kubecon-cloudnativecon-europe/)
- [Node\.js Global Summit '25 AI Edition](https://www.heroku.com/events/2025/nodejs-global-summit25-ai-edition/)
- [TDX Tokyo](https://www.heroku.com/events/2025/tdx-tokyo/): TDX Tokyo: Unlock the Agentforce era\! Hands\-on conference for tech leaders \& developers to master next\-gen AI agents\.
- [TDX Bengaluru](https://www.heroku.com/events/2025/tdx-bengaluru/): Join TDX Bengaluru for 2 days of deep AI agent insights \& hands\-on Agentforce training \(250\+ sessions\)\.

## Podcasts
- [Getting Started with Slack Apps and Slack AI](https://www.heroku.com/codeish-podcasts/getting-started-with-slack-apps-and-slack-ai/): \<p\>Slack can be so much more than a way to chat with your colleagues\. In this episode of Code\[ish\], we’re joined by Maria José Hernández to find out how Slack Apps and Slack AI can elevate the app into an organization\-wide, personalized work OS\.\</p\>
- [Kubernetes World: Finding Your Path in the Cloud Native Ecosystem](https://www.heroku.com/codeish-podcasts/kubernetes-finding-your-path-in-the-cloud-native-ecosystem/): Bart Farrell from KubeFM and LearnKube joins Julian and Yadin to discuss Kubernetes World: Finding Your Path in the Cloud Native Ecosystem, a new free ebook and career guide that helps new community members navigate the complex Kubernetes landscape\. From the importance of a welcoming community to a behind\-the\-scenes look at how the ebook was created, this episode will interest all cloud\-native professionals\.
- [Heroku in the Wild: Saving Lives with Nonprofit Watch Duty](https://www.heroku.com/codeish-podcasts/saving-lives-with-nonprofit-watch-duty/): During the Los Angeles wildfires in 2025, more than 10 million people relied on Watch Duty for potentially life\-saving information\. On this episode of Code\[ish\], its Cofounder and CTO Dave Merrick talks Julián Duque through how the application works and the technologies like Heroku that make it possible\.
- [Special Episode: Active for Good](https://www.heroku.com/codeish-podcasts/special-episode-active-for-good/): \<p\>During a time of uncertainty, it can be helpful to remember that opportunities to provide help are all around us\. One such group with a unique approach to philanthropy is Active for Good\. Active for Good is an app which tracks the number of calories you burn, and in exchange for that movement, donates a meal packet to malnourished children\. Troy Hickerson and Luke Mysse join Charlie Gleason to talk about their work on Active for Good, sharing their personal stories of how they got involved as well as providing inspiration on what "good tech" can look like\.\</p\>
- [Special Episode: Scaling Businesses During a Pandemic](https://www.heroku.com/codeish-podcasts/special-episode-scaling-businesses-during-a-pandemic/): \<p\>The COVID pandemic has forever changed the way businesses operate; many shops have had to shut down, due to the lack of foot traffic\. For the others who were fortunate enough to shift online, questions around distribution and logistics increased as visitor traffic spiked\. Ryan Townsend, the CTO of SHIFT Commerce, discusses the ways in which his PaaS has helped online retailers manage higher order volumes efficiently\.\</p\>
